summary: Tencent Cloud TokenHub gives root accounts a one-time free trial quota per eligible model. Each eligible language model gets 1,000,000 free tokens valid 1 year from claim; the campaign enrollment end is December 31, 2026, distinct from the quota's usage validity. Other model types may have different validity periods; confirm the claimed package. TokenHub is an OpenAI-compatible gateway serving DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax and other models. Claiming or enabling postpaid for a model freezes USD 1 of account balance, returned after resources are terminated. Postpaid is optional: without it, service stops when the free quota is exhausted or expires.
claim_steps: Log in to the TokenHub console and activate the platform.

On the Model Gallery page, click 'New User Free Trial', select models, then 'Claim Now'. Free trial can also be auto-claimed on first invocation of a supported model. Each root account can claim once per model.

Maintain enough balance or credit limit: USD 1 is frozen per model claim/postpaid enablement and returned after resources are terminated. Delete all model endpoints to reclaim it; deleting a default endpoint requires customer service.
Use language-model quota within 1 year of claim; unused quota expires. Confirm validity for other model types. Campaign enrollment ends December 31, 2026.
Postpaid is optional. Without it, service stops after the free quota is exhausted or expires; enabling it bills subsequent token usage at the model's rates.

social_proof.title: New User Free Trial Package — LLM Service TokenHub
social_proof.text: All language models provide a free trial quota of 1 million Tokens, valid for 1 year. ... This campaign is valid until December 31, 2026. ... Each time you claim a free resource package for a model or enable postpaid service for a model, USD 1 will be automatically frozen in your account.
